request.tone: foggy mystery with moderate scariness and peril, no violence; courage and honesty rewarded
request.note: plan written by reading an existing book; no request text exists

pitch.hero: Mira, a girl stranded on a foggy headland after missing the last bus
pitch.want: to find out what the ghost light in the abandoned lighthouse is and what became of keeper Ferris
pitch.obstacle: fog, rotten rails and rungs, rising tide, locked doors and a smuggler's hidden store
pitch.stake: a fall or a soaking that sends her home with nothing, or a buried truth and a wronged keeper
pitch.ending_kind: branch and bottleneck mystery: many solved endings, safe setbacks for rash choices

mira.name: Mira
mira.want: to understand the ghost light and what happened to Ferris, and to do the right thing with it
mira.voice: third person past; curious, careful, weighs patience against nerve; honest under temptation

ferris.name: old Ferris
ferris.role: the vanished lighthouse keeper; offstage until one ending
ferris.want: to be found and have the truth told and the tower lit true again
ferris.voice: speaks only through his log, journal, notes and letter; cramped hand, anxious then plain

smuggler.name: the smuggler
smuggler.want: the tower as a hidden store and the keeper's silence
smuggler.voice: never appears; known only by an initial in the ledger

stranger.name: the stranger in the photograph
stranger.role: unidentified man beside Ferris on the gallery; never named or explained

town_adults.name: the harbour master, clerk, constable, revenue men and coastguard
town_adults.role: offstage adults who act on Mira's evidence in the endings
town_adults.want: to set things right once shown proof

truth.question: What is the ghost light in the Hollow Lighthouse, and what happened to keeper Ferris?
truth.statement: The ghost light is a made thing: a shuttered lantern with angled mirrors, dressed with glowing cave-weed, throwing light up the tower shaft. Ferris, who had taken a smuggler's money to look away while the smuggler used the tower as a store for uncustomed goods, was driven out by the smuggler's threats. He did not vanish but fled inland to a shepherd's cottage on the moor, leaving the false light burning so someone from town would come and find the truth.

mira_missed_bus.text: Mira missed the last bus by four minutes and is out on the headland at night.

fog_headland.text: A thick fog has rolled in over the headland.

hollow_lighthouse.text: The Hollow Lighthouse stands dark and empty on the headland; nobody has lived there or wanted to since its keeper went.

ferris_keeper.text: Old Ferris was the keeper of the Hollow Lighthouse.

ferris_vanished.text: Ferris vanished from the lighthouse a year ago without a word.

light_flickers.text: Tonight a pale light flickers on and off in the empty lighthouse's lamp room.

four_ways.text: Four ways lead on from the tower grounds: the keeper's cottage, the tower stair, the sea caves and the old boathouse.

town_nearby.text: Mira's town is within walking distance of the lighthouse.

ferris_left_suddenly.text: The keeper's cottage looks as if Ferris stepped out one morning and never came back; his tea has turned to dust in its mug.

cottage_desk_shelves_hearth.text: The cottage holds a shut roll-top desk, shelves of books and treasures, and a cold hearth of dead ash.

keeper_log_last_entry.text: The keeper's log lies open on the desk at its last entry, which stops mid-sentence.

desk_drawer_locked.text: A small drawer under the desk's writing surface is locked.

ferris_lit_no_lamp.text: Ferris wrote of a light burning in the tower on nights he swore he had lit no lamp.

log_footsteps.text: Ferris's last entry tells of footsteps on the shore coming closer night after night.

hall_to_tower.text: A hallway from the cottage leads to a door into the tower.

letter_opener.text: A bent letter-opener lies on the desk, thin enough to pick the drawer's lock.

drawer_key_plan.text: The locked drawer holds a brass key in oilcloth and a plan of the cottage halls with a line inked to the tower door.

mira_has_brass_key.text: Mira is carrying a brass key she found.

ships_in_bottles.text: The shelves hold dozens of ships in bottles and a long row of leather logbooks.

bottle_paper_seen.text: One bottled ship has a curl of paper hidden in its hull, and one logbook's spine is worn shiny from use.

bottle_sketch_door.text: The paper in the bottle sketches the tower with a hidden small door at its foot.

logbook_note.text: In the worn logbook, beside a pressed sprig of sea-holly, Ferris noted: follow the hall when the light burns wrong.

hearth_buried_square.text: Something square lies unburned at the back of the hearth ash, and one firebrick sits loose.

photo_ferris_stranger.text: A half-burned photograph shows Ferris on the lamp gallery beside a stranger whose stance makes Mira's skin prickle.

brick_cavity_bundle.text: Behind the loose firebrick is a cavity holding a cloth-wrapped bundle, and the brick has jammed half out.

hearth_key_tower_mark.text: The hearth bundle holds a brass key stamped with a tower mark.

tower_mark_sketched.text: Mira has already seen the tower mark sketched somewhere in the cottage.

kitchen_shortcut.text: A dark side corridor through the kitchen also leads to the tower's inner door.

kitchen_draught.text: A cold draught smelling of stone and sea comes from a gap behind the kitchen pantry shelves.

tower_inner_door.text: A heavy inner door at the end of the hall leads into the tower.

inner_door_locked.text: The tower's inner door is locked.

inner_door_ajar.text: The tower's inner door stands ajar, just a crack.

journal_on_hook.text: The keeper's battered journal hangs on a hook beside the tower's inner door.

light_no_heat.text: In the lamp room the pale light pulses with no heat and no flame Mira can see.

lamp_room_features.text: The lamp room holds the great glass lens, a door to the outside gallery walk and a clockwork weight on a chain.

glow_not_from_lens.text: The great lens is not lit; the glow is thrown up through a cracked panel near its base.

second_reflector.text: A small second reflector has been fitted, on purpose and recently, behind the old lens.

glow_from_below.text: The light's true source is far below the lamp room, rising up a shaft through the tower's heart.

light_is_made.text: The ghost light is a built mechanism, made by hand, not a ghost or magic.

stair_down_beside_lens.text: A narrow stair beside the lens curls down along the light shaft.

gallery_rail_rusted.text: The gallery walk's iron rail is thick with rust above a drop hidden by fog.

rail_trembles.text: The gallery rail shivers under Mira's hand; it might hold or might not.

grille_glow.text: A thin glow leaks from a grille set low near the tower's base.

chain_shaft.text: The clockwork weight's chain runs down a narrow shaft.

clock_trapdoor.text: Winding the clockwork drops open a section of floor onto a narrow stair down into the tower's core.

maintenance_stair.text: A worn but sturdy maintenance stair curls down beside the chain shaft.

spiral_or_hatch.text: The way down splits into a worn spiral stair and a cramped service hatch.

tower_base_landing.text: A low landing lies at the very foot of the tower.

journal_on_stool.text: The keeper's battered journal lies open on an old stool on the landing at the tower's foot.

journal_found.text: Mira has found the keeper's battered journal, his private record.

journal_found_on_desk.text: Mira found the keeper's journal resting on the desk in the keeper's room.

caves_three_ways.text: From the cave's entrance pool three ways open: a wet passage inland, a shelf of glimmering tide pools, and a carved stone arch.

tide_coming_in.text: The tide is coming in and the water in the caves is rising.

cave_stair_up.text: A stair cut in the rock climbs out of the caves toward the tower.

glowing_weed.text: The tide pools glow with weed the same pale colour as the light above the tower.

pool_metal_gleam.text: A dull gleam of metal lies half buried in one tide pool.

weed_paints_light.text: The glowing weed is almost certainly what paints the tower's ghost light; a trick of nature someone clever noticed.

tide_badge.text: Mira finds a keeper's brass tide-badge on a broken chain in the pool.

arch_tally_marks.text: The low arch is scratched with rows of tally marks above a warning in cramped shorthand.

narrow_gap.text: Beyond the arch the passage narrows to a gap barely wide enough for Mira's shoulders.

tally_unlogged_nights.text: The tally marks count dozens of nights the tower light burned that no keeper ever logged lighting.

under_tower_two_ways.text: Directly under the tower, worn steps and a bolted iron ladder both lead up.

boathouse_contents.text: The leaning boathouse holds a tarp-covered dinghy, a rusted tool locker and a rickety ladder to a loft.

oilskins_tin.text: Under the dinghy's tarp lie folded oilskins and a bailing tin that rattles.

chart_passage.text: A coastal chart under the oilskins shows a passage inked under the lighthouse itself.

boathouse_floor_hatch.text: A floor hatch in the boathouse leads down toward the tower.

signal_note.text: A note in the bailing tin says: the light is not a ghost, it is a signal.

light_is_signal.text: The light is a signal, not a haunting.

rope_lantern_locker.text: The tool locker holds a strong coil of rope and a rusted storm lantern half full of oil.

mira_has_rope.text: Mira is carrying a coil of rope.

mira_has_lantern.text: Mira is carrying a lit lantern.

loft_ladder_rotten.text: The loft ladder is missing rungs and one near the top is cracked through.

flash_code_diagram.text: The loft holds signal flags and a diagram of lamp-flash patterns like a code; someone studied the tower's light closely.

boathouse_storm.text: The boathouse door bangs in a rising storm wind.

journal_light_entries.text: The journal holds anxious entries about a light that burned wrong night after night.

journal_cargo_ledger.text: The journal holds a ledger of undeclared cargoes landed after dark.

journal_tunnel_sketch.text: The journal holds a hurried sketch of a tunnel running beneath the tower.

journal_light_pages.text: Two journal pages stand out: a detailed description of how the glow behaves and a column of odd dates.

ferris_light_unexplained.text: Ferris could not explain the light's source and could only guess at a mechanism hidden below.

hidden_stair.text: A hidden stair in the tower's core is the way onward.

light_dates_foggy.text: Every date the strange light burned was a foggy night.

light_tied_to_cargo.text: The light's nights are the nights secret cargoes were landed; the light and the smuggling are linked.

hidden_panel.text: A hidden panel in the landing wall swings back onto the hidden stair.

cargo_signed_initial.text: Each cargo entry is signed with a single initial that is not the keeper's.

someone_used_tower.text: Someone other than Ferris has been using the tower.

ledger_unbalanced.text: The ledger shows goods coming in again and again but almost nothing leaving.

torn_page.text: One ledger page has been torn out in a hurry.

tower_private_store.text: Someone has used the empty tower as a private store for goods nobody wanted found.

torn_page_store.text: The torn-out page names a hidden store deep in the tower, stocked with undeclared goods.

one_smuggler.text: The coded initials resolve to a single smuggler.

ferris_paid_look_away.text: For years Ferris took money from the smuggler to look the other way.

smuggler_stopped_paying.text: Near the end the payments stopped, as if the smuggler wanted only the tower, not the keeper.

cellar_door.text: A low cellar door with a heavy lock sits in the landing's shadowed corner.

tunnel_to_sea_gate.text: The sketched tunnel runs from beneath the tower out under a sea gate.

marked_flagstone.text: A loose flagstone on the landing is marked with the sketch's small cross.

stair_only_dry_way.text: The sketch marks the hidden stair as the only dry way down to the tunnel; the other routes flood.

stair_splits.text: The hidden stair splits into a tight winding stair inside the walls and outer steps open to the fog.

hollow_step.text: One step near the top of the winding stair sounds hollow.

outer_gust.text: A gust on the outer steps pushes Mira sideways against the tower.

frosted_door.text: The climb ends at a small warm door of frosted glass glowing from the light behind it.

lamp_rig.text: Behind the frosted door a shuttered lantern rigged with angled mirrors throws the pale glow up the tower's shaft.

rig_dressed_weed.text: The lantern rig is dressed with strands of glowing cave-weed, which gives the light its eerie colour.

three_ways_down.text: From the light chamber a broad stone stair, a narrow service shaft and an outer ladder lead down.

landing_cupboard.text: A cupboard on the stone stair's landing holds Ferris's belongings: lamp parts, wire and a coat smelling of pipe smoke.

spare_lens_marks.text: A spare lens in the cupboard is scored with marks that match the mirror rig.

coat_note.text: A note in Ferris's coat pocket, in his hand, reads: gone but not lost.

undercroft.text: A damp undercroft at the foot of the tower opens onto a tunnel mouth.

shaft_staples_rope.text: The service shaft has iron staples in one wall and a frayed knotted rope beside them.

outer_ladder_fog.text: The outer ladder runs down the tower's flank, slick and lost in dense fog.

brick_tunnel.text: A low brick tunnel runs beneath the lighthouse out under the rock toward the sea.

tunnel_lantern_lit.text: Mira lights the old storm lantern that hangs at the tunnel mouth.

tunnel_three_branches.text: The tunnel splits toward the keeper's sealed private room, a store of unmarked crates, and a barred sea gate.

crate_store.text: A store under the tower is stacked with crates and barrels bearing no marks of origin.

oak_door_key_in_lock.text: The keeper's sealed door is brass-bound oak with his mark burned in, and a rusted old key sits in its lock.

fallen_beam.text: A heavy beam has fallen across the passage by the keeper's door.

lock_rusted.text: The key in the keeper's door catches on rust deep in the lock.

ledger_box.text: A small locked ledger box sits on top of the crates.

smuggled_goods.text: The crates hold lamp oil and fine cloth that never passed an honest customs house: a smuggler's haul.

ledger_box_lists.text: The ledger box holds cramped lists of names, dates and figures for goods that never passed customs.

draft_lantern.text: A cold draft worries Mira's lantern flame down to a weak flicker.

sea_gate_tide.text: At the barred sea gate the rising tide is climbing the slick lower bars.

current_ledge.text: Through the gate a narrow ledge is swept by a strong cold current.

keeper_room.text: The keeper's sealed room under the sea is snug and dry, with an unlit lamp, a made bunk and a desk.

sealed_letter.text: A sealed letter lies at the centre of the keeper's desk.

letter_address.text: The letter is addressed: to whoever is brave enough to climb.

smuggler_drove_ferris.text: A smuggler drove Ferris out of his own tower.

ferris_left_light_burning.text: Ferris left the false light burning behind him when he went.

ferris_alive.text: Ferris is alive; he did not truly vanish but went into hiding.

ferris_fled_inland.text: Ferris fled the smuggler's threats and hid inland.

light_meant_to_bring_town.text: Ferris left the light burning so that someone from town would eventually come looking and find the truth.

letter_map.text: The letter includes a small map to Ferris's hiding place.

ferris_confession.text: The letter includes Ferris's signed confession that he looked away from the smuggling for money.

ferris_plea.text: The letter ends with a plea for whoever reads it to help make things right.

plea_sorry_light.text: Ferris asks that they be told he is sorry, and that the tower be lit true again.

shepherds_cottage.text: The map leads across the inland moor to a small shepherd's cottage far from the coast.

harbour_office.text: The town has a harbour office that can organise a search.

smuggler_wanted_all.text: On one terrible night the smuggler demanded everything: the tower and the keeper's silence.

letter_kept_sealed.text: Mira keeps the letter sealed to hand to whoever should rightly open it.

mira_has_phone.text: Mira has a phone she can photograph evidence with.

evidence_photos.text: Mira photographs the crates and the ledger box as evidence.

hidden_hoard.text: Deeper in lies the smuggler's private hoard, separate from the store, with a jewelled compass on top.

hoard_photographed.text: Mira photographs the whole hidden hoard crate by crate without touching it.

ferris_built_rig.text: Ferris built the light rig as a coded warning system to alert passing ships without giving himself away.

mirror_guide_marks.text: Ferris scratched guide marks into the mirror frame long ago to guide its repair.

light_restored.text: Mira relights the tower's true lamp; a clean beam sweeps the fog for the first time in a year.

signal_can_call.text: The signal rig can flash a coded call across the water.

journal_flash_code.text: The keeper's journal holds a coded flash pattern that Mira has studied.

drawer_split.text: The wrenched drawer splits and jams the desk shut; Mira leaves the cottage's secrets for the night.

brick_rubble.text: A slide of rubble seals the hearth cavity and buries what it held.

rail_rotten.text: The gallery rail sags under Mira's weight; she retreats into the lamp room to wait for dawn.

tide_retreat.text: Mira wades back from the rising tide to a dry ledge and waits, safe but no closer to an answer.

gap_backed_out.text: Mira wriggles back out of the narrow gap and leaves it behind.

rung_snaps.text: The cracked rung snaps and drops Mira to the boathouse floor, bruised only in pride.

hatch_buried.text: The storm slams the boathouse door and a shelf of gear buries the floor hatch; Mira walks home.

cellar_lantern_dies.text: At the open cellar door Mira's lantern gutters out; she waits in the dark for morning.

step_crumbles.text: The hollow step crumbles under Mira and she turns back down the hidden stair.

rope_frays.text: The rope frays through; Mira catches the staples and climbs back up, leaving the tunnel unreached.

fog_turns_back.text: Mira will not climb blind and edges back up the ladder to wait for the fog to lift.

wards_broken.text: Forcing the key shears the wards and jams the keeper's door shut for good.

beam_pins_coat.text: The beam shifts and pins Mira's coat; she tears free and backs out.

gate_surge.text: The sea surges to Mira's waist at the gate and she wades back; the tide wins.

bell_wire_patrol.text: A hidden bell-wire chimes as Mira pockets the compass; a dawn patrol waits with hard questions and the evidence is spoiled.

gears_jam.text: Forced gears lock solid and jam the lamp mechanism for good.

ferris_found_cottage.text: Mira finds Ferris alive at the shepherd's cottage, older and thinner than his photograph.

search_finds_ferris.text: A search party follows Mira's map and finds Ferris safe; he comes home to town.

town_suspected_ferris.text: The town had whispered suspicion against Ferris for a year.

ferris_name_cleared.text: Mira makes the town learn the truth and Ferris's good name is restored.

light_cry_for_help.text: The false light Ferris left burning was a quiet cry for help.

mira_promise.text: Mira promises to see the tower mended and the truth told, and keeps her word.

mira_sought_shelter.text: Mira had only meant to find shelter from the fog.

smuggler_caught.text: A coastguard cutter answers Mira's signal and the smuggler is caught red-handed.

smuggler_not_caught.text: Nobody is caught tonight; the smuggler's scheme is only half uncovered.

store_emptied_harbour.text: The harbour master, constable and revenue men empty the secret store.

hoard_case_sealed.text: The harbour master summons the coastguard and Mira's untouched photographs seal the case.

coast_light_returned.text: A fishing boat answers the restored beam; the coast has its light back.

rescue_lights.text: Lights from the harbour and out at sea answer Mira's call for help and everyone gets safely home.

signal_documented.text: Mira logs every mirror and shutter of the signal rig; the ghost light becomes a solved mystery.

letter_unread_carried.text: Mira carries the letter out unread into the dawn for others to open.

compass_left.text: Mira leaves the jewelled compass where it lay and photographs the hoard instead.

mystery_unsolved_town.text: Mira heads home with the mystery unsolved for now but no longer frightening.

chalk_arrows.text: Mira leaves the journal as a signpost and chalks arrows along the tunnel for whoever comes next.

journal_carried_home.text: Mira carries the keeper's journal home to hand to the town.

n_open.event: Mira, stranded in fog after missing the last bus, sees a light flicker in the abandoned Hollow Lighthouse and walks toward it.

n_start.event: Four ways open around the tower: cottage, tower stair, sea caves, boathouse.

a_office1.event: The keeper's cottage looks abandoned mid-morning; desk, shelves and hearth each might hold an answer.

a_desk.event: The roll-top desk holds the keeper's log open at its broken-off last page and a locked drawer.

a_desk_log.event: Ferris's last entry tells of a light he never lit and footsteps on the shore; Mira follows the hall toward the tower.

a_desk_drawer.event: The drawer will not give; Mira can pick it with a bent letter-opener or wrench it.

a_desk_pick.event: Mira picks the lock and finds a brass key and a plan with a line to the tower door.

a_shelf.event: The shelves hold ships in bottles and logbooks; one ship hides paper and one logbook is well worn.

a_shelf_bottle.event: The bottle's paper sketches a hidden door at the tower's foot; Mira follows the hall that way.

a_shelf_books.event: The worn logbook says to follow the hall when the light burns wrong, and it is burning wrong now.

a_hearth.event: The cold hearth hides something unburned and a loose firebrick.

a_hearth_ash.event: Mira finds a scorched photograph of Ferris with an unsettling stranger and carries it toward the hall.

a_hearth_brick.event: Behind the jammed firebrick lies a bundle; Mira can ease it out or yank the brick.

a_hearth_key.event: The bundle holds a brass key stamped with the tower mark she saw sketched elsewhere; she follows the hall.

a_corridor.event: The hall runs to the tower's inner door, with a kitchen shortcut beside; both end at the same locked door.

a_kitchen.event: A sea-smelling draught behind the pantry leads Mira round to the tower door from the other side.

a_toward.event: The tower's inner door stands ajar; Mira takes down a battered journal hanging on a hook beside it.

b_lamp1.event: At the top of the tower the light pulses without heat or flame; lens, gallery and clockwork draw her eye.

b_lens.event: The lens is unlit; the glow comes through a cracked panel, and a new hidden reflector sits behind it.

b_lens_crack.event: Through the crack Mira sees the light climbing a shaft from far below; a stair beside the lens goes down.

b_lens_reflect.event: The reflector bounces light up from below: a built trick, not a ghost. Mira takes the stair down.

b_gallery.event: The gallery rail is rotten with rust over a fog-hidden drop; walk out or look through the window.

b_gallery_out.event: The rail trembles under Mira's hand; trust it or step back.

b_gallery_fog.event: Through the window Mira sees the glow leaking from a grille at the tower's base and seeks the way down.

b_clock.event: The clockwork chain groans; wind it or follow the chain down its shaft.

b_clock_wind.event: Winding the clockwork drops open a floor section onto a stair into the tower's core.

b_clock_chain.event: Mira takes a maintenance stair beside the chain shaft down.

b_down.event: The way down splits into a spiral stair and a cramped service hatch.

b_down_spiral.event: The spiral stair ends at a landing at the tower's foot where the keeper's journal lies on a stool.

b_down_hatch.event: The hatch drops Mira onto the same low landing, where the keeper's journal waits on a stool.

c_cave1.event: The sea caves breathe with the tide; a wet passage, glowing pools and a carved arch lead on.

c_pass.event: The passage narrows and the tide is rising; push on or hesitate.

c_pass_deep.event: Mira reaches a dry ledge and slick steps cut upward toward the tower.

c_pool.event: The pools glow with weed the colour of the tower light; something metal gleams in one.

c_pool_glow.event: The weed is surely what paints the ghost light, nothing haunted; Mira follows a handrail to a cliff stair.

c_pool_metal.event: Mira fishes out a keeper's brass tide-badge and climbs a rock stair toward the tower.

c_arch.event: The arch is covered in tally marks and a shorthand warning; beyond it a tight gap.

c_arch_marks.event: The tallies count nights the light burned unlogged, and the shorthand points to a stair up away from the rising sea.

c_arch_gap.event: Wedged sideways in the gap, Mira can wriggle on or back out.

c_gather.event: The stair brings Mira under the tower, where worn steps and an iron ladder lead up.

c_steps.event: The steps reach a dry landing in the tower's base where the keeper's journal lies on a stool.

c_ladder.event: The ladder reaches the same low landing, where the keeper's journal waits on its stool.

d_boat1.event: The leaning boathouse holds a dinghy, a tool locker and a ladder to a loft.

d_dinghy.event: Under the dinghy's tarp are oilskins and a rattling bailing tin.

d_dinghy_tarp.event: A chart shows a passage under the lighthouse, pointing to a floor hatch in the corner.

d_dinghy_tin.event: The tin holds a brass key and a note: the light is not a ghost, it is a signal. Mira goes to the floor hatch.

d_locker.event: The locker holds rope and a half-full storm lantern; Mira picks one.

d_locker_rope.event: Mira takes the rope and notices a well-worn floor hatch.

d_locker_lantern.event: Mira lights the lantern and spots a well-worn floor hatch.

d_loft.event: The loft ladder is rotten, with one cracked rung near the top.

d_loft_up.event: The loft holds signal flags and a lamp-flash code diagram; a trapdoor drops her by the floor hatch she noticed earlier.

d_hatch.event: The floor hatch is stiff and the storm is rising behind her.

d_hatch_down.event: The passage under the rock reaches a landing at the tower's base where the keeper's journal lies on a stool.

n_journal.event: Every path leads to the same journal: entries on the wrong light, a ledger of night cargoes, a tunnel sketch.

jr_light.event: Ferris's light entries grow uneasy; a detailed description and a column of dates stand out.

jr_light_read.event: Ferris wrote the light is made, its source hidden below, and underlined: take the hidden stair.

jr_light_date.event: The dates are all foggy nights, the same nights cargoes were landed; a note points to a hidden stair.

jr_light_join.event: Mira presses the landing wall where the journal says and a hidden panel opens on a cramped stair.

jr_smug.event: The cargo ledger is signed with an initial not the keeper's; someone else used the tower.

jr_smug_ledger.event: The figures never balance and one page has been torn out.

jr_smug_copy.event: Mira copies the totals into her notebook as proof of a private store; a margin note points to the hidden stair.

jr_smug_torn.event: The torn page, tucked in the back cover, names a hidden store and gives directions to the hidden stair.

jr_smug_names.event: The initials resolve to one smuggler who paid Ferris to look away, then stopped paying.

jr_smug_join.event: The ledger points to the hidden stair, but a locked cellar door sits in the landing's corner.

jr_tunnel.event: The sketch shows a tunnel out under a sea gate; a marked flagstone sits loose on the landing.

jr_tun_sketch.event: The sketch marks the hidden stair as the only dry way; a matching wall panel opens.

jr_tun_stone.event: The flagstone is rusted fast; heave it or trust the sketch's drier route.

jr_tun_join.event: The sketch wins: the wall panel already stands open and Mira starts up the hidden stair.

n_stairs.event: All journal threads lead to the hidden stair, which splits into a tight winding stair and fog-exposed outer steps.

st_wind.event: On the winding stair one step near the top sounds hollow.

st_wind_up.event: Keeping to the wall, Mira reaches a warm glowing frosted-glass door.

st_outer.event: A gust on the outer steps shoves Mira; push on or wait.

st_outer_wait.event: Mira waits out the gust and climbs to a glowing frosted-glass door.

st_outer_up.event: The outer steps deliver Mira to a small frosted-glass door with the light just behind it.

n_light.event: The ghost light is a shuttered lantern with mirrors, dressed with the cave-weed she saw below: a made signal. Three ways lead down.

li_stair.event: A cupboard on the stone stair's landing holds the keeper's things.

li_stair_down.event: Mira descends past the lamp-rig's wiring to a damp undercroft and a tunnel mouth.

li_stair_cup.event: The cupboard holds a spare lens marked like the mirror rig and Ferris's storm coat.

li_cup_lens.event: The lens's rig-marks prove the light was hand-built; Mira continues down toward the tunnel.

li_cup_coat.event: Ferris's coat pocket holds a note: gone but not lost. Mira continues to the tunnel mouth.

li_shaft.event: The shaft offers iron staples or a frayed knotted rope; both hold, for now.

li_shaft_down.event: The staples hold and Mira reaches the undercroft floor and the tunnel opening.

li_shaft_rope.event: The rope creaks under her weight; trust it or pull back.

li_ladder.event: The outer ladder vanishes into thick fog; keep climbing down blind or turn back.

li_ladder_down.event: Mira climbs down blind, reaches the ground and ducks into the tunnel mouth.

n_tunnel.event: Mira lights a lantern at the brick tunnel's mouth; it splits toward the keeper's room on the sketch, a crate store and a sea gate.

tn_keeper.event: The keeper's sealed oak door has a rusted key in its lock, and a fallen beam blocks the passage behind.

tn_keep_door.event: The key turns halfway and catches on rust; coax or shove.

tn_keep_open.event: The keeper's door swings open on a small sealed room.

tn_keep_stuck.event: The key sticks; forcing it may snap the wards.

tn_keep_beam.event: Lever the wedged beam clear or squeeze under it.

tn_store.event: A store of unmarked crates and barrels, with a locked ledger box on top.

tn_store_crate.event: The crate holds uncustomed lamp oil and cloth, a smuggler's haul in the supposedly haunted tower.

tn_store_box.event: The ledger box holds lists of uncustomed goods: proof enough on its own.

tn_store_join.event: A draft gutters the lantern she lit at the tunnel mouth; press on or trim the wick.

tn_store_relight.event: Mira trims the wick and follows the clear passage to the keeper's door she knows from the sketch.

tn_gate.event: The tide is climbing the sea gate's bars; open it or think twice.

tn_gate_open.event: Through the gate a strong current tugs at Mira on a narrow ledge.

tn_gate_wait.event: Mira waits out the current and climbs a dry passage toward the keeper's room.

n_chamber.event: In the keeper's snug room a sealed letter promises the truth of Ferris, the smuggler who drove him out, and the light he left burning.

cm_letter.event: The letter is addressed to whoever is brave enough to climb; read it or keep it sealed.

cm_letter_read.event: Ferris fled the smuggler and hid inland, leaving the light to draw someone; a map, a confession and a plea follow.

cm_letter_map.event: The map leads to a shepherd's cottage on the moor; go herself or take word to the harbour office.

cm_letter_conf.event: The confession admits years of paid blind eyes and the night the smuggler demanded everything.

cm_letter_plea.event: Ferris asks that they be told he is sorry and the tower lit true; Mira takes up the task.

cm_letter_keep.event: Mira decides the letter is not hers to open and keeps it sealed.

cm_smug.event: With the store laid bare, Mira can photograph everything or follow the passage deeper.

cm_smug_photo.event: Mira photographs the crates and ledger box; signal the coastguard with the tower rig or go to the harbour master.

cm_smug_follow.event: Deeper lies the smuggler's private hoard topped by a tempting jewelled compass.

cm_smug_hoard.event: Mira photographs the whole hoard methodically without touching it.

cm_smug_token.event: Mira's hand hovers over the compass, torn between easy proof and the right choice.

cm_light.event: The rig's secret is out; relight the true lamp or study Ferris's coded warning signal.

cm_light_relight.event: Set the mirror true by Ferris's old guide marks, or force the stiff gears.

cm_light_true.event: Mira aligns the mirror by the marks and the true lamp flares, sweeping the fog for the first time in a year.

cm_light_study.event: The rig can flash a coded call; send for help now or log how it was built.

cm_leave.event: Bone-tired, Mira weighs heading straight to town against marking the way for others.

cm_leave_town.event: Mira fixes the keeper's room in memory and starts the long walk to town to tell it all in the morning.

cm_leave_mark.event: Leave the journal open on the desk where she found it as a signpost, or carry it to town.

e_set_a_drawer.event: The wrenched drawer splits and jams the desk; Mira leaves the cottage to the fog.

e_set_a_brick.event: Rubble buries the hearth cavity; Mira waits out the night by the door.

e_set_b_rail.event: The rotten rail sags; Mira retreats to the lamp room to wait for dawn.

e_set_c_tide.event: The tide rises to her knees; Mira waits safe on a dry ledge.

e_set_c_stuck.event: Mira wriggles back out of the gap and leaves it behind.

e_set_d_loft.event: The cracked rung snaps and Mira limps out to wait for morning.

e_set_d_storm.event: The storm buries the floor hatch under fallen gear and Mira walks home.

e_set_cellar.event: Her borrowed lantern dies at the cellar door; Mira waits in the dark for morning.

e_set_stair.event: The hollow step crumbles and Mira turns back down the hidden climb.

e_set_shaft.event: The rope frays; Mira catches the staples and climbs back up.

e_set_fog.event: Mira will not climb blind and waits above for the fog to lift.

e_set_door.event: Forcing the key breaks the wards and seals the keeper's room for good.

e_set_beam.event: The beam pins Mira's coat; she tears free and backs out.

e_set_gate.event: The sea surges at the gate and Mira wades back to wait.

e_set_token.event: A bell-wire chimes as she pockets the compass; a dawn patrol waits and the evidence is spoiled.

e_set_gears.event: The forced gears jam the lamp mechanism for good.

e_win_keeper_found.event: Mira follows the map to the shepherd's cottage and finds Ferris alive.

e_win_keeper_word.event: The harbour office sends a search that finds Ferris; he comes home cleared.

e_win_name_cleared.event: Mira spreads the confession's truth and Ferris's good name is restored.

e_win_promise.event: Mira promises to mend the tower and tell the truth, and keeps her word.

e_win_smugglers.event: Mira flashes the journal's code; a coastguard cutter answers and the smuggler is caught.

e_win_harbor.event: The harbour master and revenue men empty the store on Mira's proof.

e_win_hoard.event: Mira's untouched photographs of the hoard seal the case.

e_win_light_restored.event: The restored beam sweeps the coast and a fishing boat answers.

e_win_rescue.event: Mira's coded call brings answering lights and everyone home safe.

e_win_signal.event: Mira documents the rig; the ghost light becomes a solved mystery.

e_neutral_letter.event: Mira carries the sealed letter out unread into the dawn.

e_neutral_honest.event: Mira leaves the compass and photographs the hoard; nobody is caught tonight.

e_neutral_town.event: Mira heads home with the mystery unsolved but no longer frightening.

e_neutral_evidence.event: Mira leaves the journal on the desk as a signpost and chalks arrows in the tunnel.

e_neutral_museum.event: Mira carries the keeper's journal home to hand to the town.
